description: Add or remove tags on an email already sent, scheduled or held, to refile it for the tag filters of list_emails and list_threads. Removals apply first, then additions, so one call swaps a tag: remove_tags [{name:'recovery_case'}] (no value: every tag with that name) with add_tags [{name:'category', value:'billing-recovery'}]. The thread and the dashboard's tag suggestions follow. Changes only what SendRaven stores, not what the provider already saw. Safe to repeat. Answers the email as get_email does. broadcast_id, set on campaign mail, cannot be changed (422 invalid_request), nor can a message end with more than 10 tags. An unknown id answers 404 not_found.

add_tags.description: Pairs to add; one already present is not added twice

remove_tags.description: Tags to take off; leave value out to remove every tag with that name

name: update_email_tags
